Verses.1:
Come, everyone who is thirsty,
	come to the waters!
You who have no money,
	come, buy and eat!
Come, buy wine and milk
	without money and without cost!
Verses.2:
Why spend money on what is not bread,
	and your wages on what does not satisfy?
Listen to me carefully, and eat what is good,
	and delight yourself in the richest food.
Verses.3:
Incline your ear and come to Me.
	Listen, that your soul may live;
I will make an everlasting covenant with you,
	my faithful and sure love promised to David.
Verses.4:
Behold, I have made him a witness to the peoples,
	a leader and commander for the peoples.
Verses.5:
Behold, you will summon a nation you do not know,
	and a nation you do not know will run to you.
All because of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel,
	for He has adorned you with splendor.
Verses.6:
Seek the LORD while He may be found!
	Call upon Him while He is near!
Verses.7:
Let the wicked abandon their way,
	and the unrighteous one their thoughts.
Let them return to the LORD,
	and He will have compassion on them,
and to our God,
	for He will abundantly pardon.
Verses.8:
"For My thoughts are not your thoughts,
	neither are your ways My ways," declares the LORD.
Verses.9:
"For the heavens are higher than the earth.
	so are My ways higher than your ways,
	and My thoughts higher than your thoughts.
Verses.10:
For the rains and snows fall from heaven,
	and do not return without watering the earth.
They make the earth sprout, flourish,
	and bring forth seed for the sower, and bread to eat.
Verses.11:
It is the same when My word goes forth from My mouth.
	It will not return to Me empty.
My word will accomplish what I desire,
	and fulfill the purpose I sent it for.
Verses.12:
For you will go out in joy
	and be led in peace!
The mountains and hills will burst into song before you,
	and all the trees in the countryside will clap their hands.
Verses.13:
Instead of the thorn bush, the juniper will grow,
	and instead of briers, the myrtle will grow.
It will be for the LORD's renown,
	an everlasting sign which will endure forever."

Changes: 2024-06-05 - Paul Prins: Initial translation of verses 1-13.
